items.prompt: Why can a queue storing only the value 7 be ambiguous after two arrivals of 7?

options.text: Equal values are forbidden by the task.
The value alone does not identify which arrival has expired.
options.why: Indexes bind a candidate to its exact position in the moving window.

options.text: Every equal value must be added to get the maximum.
options.why: Window maximum selects an observed value, not a sum.

options.text: A deque cannot store duplicate values.
options.why: The container permits duplicates; membership and expiration are the issue.

items.explanation: Indexes bind a candidate to its exact position in the moving window.
